# sendio_contact_property (Resource)

A custom contact property (for example `company` or `plan`). Destroying it removes the value from every contact.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "sendio_contact_property" "plan" {
  key            = "plan"
  type           = "string"
  fallback_value = "free"
}

resource "sendio_contact_property" "seats" {
  key  = "seats"
  type = "number"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) Property key: letters, digits and underscores, at most 50 characters. Changing it creates a new property.
- `type` (String) `string` or `number`. Changing it creates a new property.

### Optional

- `fallback_value` (String) Value used where a contact has none (a number for `number` properties).

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the contact property was created.
- `id` (String) Contact property id.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import sendio_contact_property.plan 7e8f9a0b-1c2d-4e3f-8a4b-5c6d7e8f9a0b
```
